name: Bake Sausage Southwest
description: A layered casserole featuring sausage, tortillas, cheese, and salsa, perfect for a hearty breakfast or brunch.
recipeIngredient: 1 lb bulk pork sausage, cooked and drained
4 cans (4 oz each) green chilies, drained and chopped
2 cups (8 oz) shredded Monterey Jack cheese
1/2 cup sour cream and salsa for serving

recipeInstructions.text: In a greased 13x9x2 inch baking pan, create a layer of tortillas.
In a bowl, beat eggs and milk together, then pour over tortillas.
Sprinkle with garlic salt, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Layer with cooked sausage, chopped green chilies, and shredded cheese.
Repeat layers as needed, finishing with a layer of cheese on top.
Refrigerate overnight, covered.
Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before baking.
Arrange tomato slices on top and bake uncovered at 350°F for 50 minutes.
Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting and serve with sour cream and salsa.

keywords: Southwestern casserole, sausage bake, breakfast strata

_similar.name: Mexican Enchilada Bake
_similar.description: A hearty, layered casserole featuring chicken, tortillas, and a rich tomato-salsa sauce, topped with cheese and sour cream.
recipeIngredient: 2½ cups tomato sauce or ¾ cup each diced carrots and diced canned tomatoes
1 can (19 oz) black beans, rinsed and drained

recipeInstructions.text: Combine tomato sauce, salsa, 2 teaspoons chili powder, and 2 teaspoons cumin in a medium saucepan. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer, covered, for 5 minutes.
In a large bowl, mix together chicken, rice, beans, carrots, red pepper, onion, lime juice, cilantro, remaining 2 teaspoons chili powder, and remaining 1 teaspoon cumin.
Spray a 9×13 inch baking dish with nonstick spray.
To assemble the casserole, spread 1 cup of sauce over the bottom of the baking dish. Arrange 6 tortillas over the bottom, overlapping as necessary.
Spoon another 1 cup of sauce over the tortillas and spread evenly. Top with half of the bean mixture and half of the cheese.
Arrange the remaining tortillas, top with another 1 cup of sauce, followed by the remaining bean mixture and remaining cheese.
Spoon any remaining sauce over the top. Cover with foil and bake at 350°F for 35 to 40 minutes until bubbly and heated through.
Let stand for 5 minutes before serving. Top individual servings with a dollop of sour cream.

_similar.keywords: enchilada bake, Mexican casserole, chicken recipe

_similar.name: Cauliflower Christmas
_similar.description: A layered cauliflower dish with Swiss cheese, green peppers, and mushrooms, baked until golden.

recipeInstructions.text: Saute the green peppers and mushrooms in butter until tender.
Add flour to the sautéed mixture and stir to combine.
Gradually stir in milk, bringing the mixture to a boil.
Remove from heat and add shredded cheese, stirring until melted.
In a greased baking dish, layer half of the cauliflower.
Top with half of the cheese sauce and half of the pimiento.
Repeat the layers, finishing with the remaining cauliflower and sauce.
Sprinkle with paprika.
Bake uncovered at 325°F for 25 minutes.

_similar.name: Surprise Spread
_similar.description: A layered seafood dip with shrimp, cocktail sauce, and cheese.
recipeIngredient: 3 (4 oz) cans small shrimp, rinsed and drained
Tortilla chips or assorted crackers for serving

recipeInstructions.text: Mix the cream cheese, sour cream, and mayonnaise together until smooth.
Spread this mixture in the bottom of a deep pie plate, pizza pan, or shallow baking dish.
Scatter the shrimp over the top.
Cover with the seafood cocktail sauce.
Add layers of mozzarella cheese, green pepper, and green onions.
Top with diced tomatoes if desired.
Chill until ready to serve with tortilla chips or crackers.

_similar.name: Taco Twist Bake
_similar.description: A hearty taco-flavored pasta bake with ground beef, spaghetti sauce, and melted cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Preheat oven to 350°F and start water to cook for pasta.
In a frying pan, brown the ground beef with the onions until the meat is no longer pink. Drain off excess fat.
Add mushrooms, taco seasoning, and water. Simmer for about 15 minutes.
Add spaghetti sauce, salsa, and green pepper. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes more.
Cook the spiral pasta, then rinse and drain.
Combine pasta with sour cream.
Pour the pasta mixture into a greased 6-cup casserole dish or square baking dish.
Sprinkle with approximately half of the shredded cheddar cheese.
Cover with the meat mixture and bake, uncovered, at 350°F for approximately 20 minutes.
Top with remaining cheese and bake for another 5 to 10 minutes, or until the cheese is melted.

_similar.keywords: taco pasta bake, ground beef recipe, cheesy casserole
